title: geranium anthemidifolium
intro: Geranium anthemidifolium, commonly known as Mexican geranium or dwarf geranium, is a perennial plant species native to Mexico and Central America, characterized by its small, rounded leaves and delicate white or pink flowers. The plant has been found to possess various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. Its therapeutic actions include reducing anxiety and stress through its calming effects, as well as exhibiting antioxidant properties that can protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Geranium anthemidifolium include geraniol, linalool, and geranial, which are responsible for its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
